snippet.title: Grave Of Voices | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Grave Of Voices | Official Announcement Trailer

Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3977320/Grave_Of_Voices/

A horror explorer and YouTuber receives a strange email about a forgotten town near his apartment. What begins as a simple video idea turns into a nightmare when the gate closes behind him.

Developed by @BoundlessBite
